ordering: counterbalanced cyclic rotation of four arms by task index, frozen before results

fixed.responsibility: one lead with fixed power and firmware scopes

joint.responsibility: one lead; explicitly choose interface information, shared-context or joint-experiment scope based on observed facts

information: identical task, full frozen candidate, documentation and execution/result access; returned worker history archived and read on demand
adoption_rule: Keep a scoped-source method only when source facts are correct and parent consumes them, and matched total cost or errors/rework improves; retain null/negative outcomes. No tuning on final tests.
inference: descriptive finite pilot, one replicate per task-arm; report task-level results, no population efficacy claim
budget: user explicitly authorizes unlimited cumulative money/time for this finite list; usage/UNKNOWN and all failures retained
